# Version 4.158.0 (Unreleased)
> **Stronger per process hash seeds**

## Highlights

Upcoming SkiaSharp changes use operating-system randomness for the shared hash-code seed.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this preview line.*

## Lifecycle & Internals

- **Hash-code initialization updated** — The HashCode polyfill shared by SkiaSharp and HarfBuzzSharp now seeds from RandomNumberGenerator rather than System.Random. Hash codes remain stable within a process and randomized between processes; first use now loads cryptography support and has additional initialization cost. — ❤️ [@rolfbjarne](https://github.com/rolfbjarne) ([#5408](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5408))
